summary: Full e2e verification of YOURFM DJ-break/ducking/weather/location changes. 15/15 backend pytest GREEN (Feed.fm proxy, voices, station CRUD, /api/weather city+temp_f, /api/bumpers/generate accepts local-weather + concert-tours + user_location, also works without user_location via auto:ip). UI: landing -> create -> play -> 4 skips -> DJ break flow ALL works. Music ducked from 1.0 -> 0.12 and back to 1.0 (verified via audioRef.volume sampling), bumper-banner appeared, /api/bumpers/generate fired EXACTLY once (not every skip - threshold worked), and the request body included user_location='34.0522,-118.2437' plus all 3 topics. Zero console errors. No Spotify UI anywhere in the user flow (no spotify references in frontend/src).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still 1158+ lines and contains dead Spotify routes (/api/spotify/*, spotipy import, db.spotify_tokens) that the UI never invokes - safe to delete now that Feed.fm is the sole audio source.

Player.jsx fadeVolume() does not clear its setInterval on unmount; if the user navigates back to Stations mid-fade the interval keeps firing on a torn-down audio element. Add a ref to track the interval id and clear it in a useEffect cleanup.
Player.jsx playBumper sets b.onended/onerror to the same resolve but never clears them; if a fresh bumper starts while a previous one is still resolving there's a minor handler leak.
StationCreate / StationUpdate models still accept feedfm_station_id as Optional - given the new product requires it, server-side validation should reject creates without it.

Voice <select> ships a placeholder option with value='' that fails the create call until ElevenLabs voices load (~1-2s). Consider disabling the Create button until voice_id is populated to avoid the validation-toast UX seen in run #1.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_yourfm_djbreak.py (new - 6 tests covering weather + bumper user_location + concert tours + auto:ip fallback)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (create, play, 4-skip DJ break, ducking 1.0->0.12->1.0, geolocation forwarded, no errors)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_DJBreak via UI, then deleted via DELETE /api/stations/<id>. Also cleaned 2 leftover stations from earlier runs. DB ends at 0 user stations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest backend/tests/test_feedfm_radio.py backend/tests/test_yourfm_djbreak.py -v` for full backend regression (15 tests, ~24s). Voice <select> needs ~1-2s after StationCreator opens before real voice_id options populate - wait on `Array.from(sel.options).map(o=>o.value).filter(Boolean).length>=1`. The <audio data-testid=music-audio> element is visibility:hidden, so use state='attached' (not 'visible') with wait_for_selector. Read .volume via page.evaluate to verify ducking. DJ break threshold is randomised 3-4; 4 skips reliably triggers exactly one /api/bumpers/generate (verified). user_location is forwarded as 'lat,lon' string when geolocation is granted; backend falls back to auto:ip otherwise. Weather is rate-limited to 25% of bumpers BY DESIGN - do not assert weather text in bumper output; assert /api/weather works directly and that the request body carries user_location.
rca of the issue: N/A - none of the reported regressions reproduce. Ducking, randomised 3-4 threshold (shared by skips+completes), geolocation forwarding, concert-tours topic, and weather endpoint are all functioning correctly.
